title: Optional Unicode and bounded spatial SQL
summary: Classic strings remain default. TUTOR Unicode is explicitly enabled per text profile and fails closed if requested but unavailable. Spatial SQL currently covers typed POINT/POLYGON accessors and point/polygon WITHIN/INTERSECTS; it does not claim full Simple Features or reprojection.
invariants: Installing TUTOR alone must not change CLASSIC columns.
UNICODE uses strict UTF-8, NFC and grapheme-aware operations where documented.
ST_WITHIN excludes polygon boundary; ST_INTERSECTS includes it.
Do not claim distance, reprojection, polygon/polygon topology, LINESTRING/MULTI* or spatial indexing at v0.79.
